note: Ship weapons (brief §6, §7). power: bars it needs. charge: seconds to ready a shot. flight: seconds the shot is in the air. damage: hull points, and system bars from S2.2. pierce: extra brace units it takes to stop (S2.8, D-075). ammo: { magazine } for a heavy gun that fires rounds carried up from the hold, one round a shot (S2.8, D-076); none for a gun that needs no rounds. effects: chances of fire and breach and harm to crew in the room, used from S2.2. mount: false marks a weapon no ship fits, such as a carrier drone's zap (S2.5). role (H.3, D-172): what a mount on our ship is for: "pd" is point defence, which fires by itself at drones on the hull and boarding pods in the air; "gun" is the deterrent gun, laid on a contact on the scope and never on a room, out to its `range` in scope units. A weapon with no role that we do not mount is what a contact fires at us (its encounter's `guns`).

items.name: Point-defence turret
items.blurb: A company-fit flak turret. It looks after itself: whatever comes at the hull small enough to shoot, a drone or a boarding pod, it shoots.

items.name: Pulse laser
items.blurb: Cheap, quick, needs nothing but power. What a patrol or a raider fires across your bow, and then into it. Stopped dead by a brace.

items.name: Slug thrower
items.blurb: A mass driver salvaged from a mining rig, and the one gun a hauler is allowed. Slow, loud, fed by hand three slugs to a load. It cannot sink anything; it can make a ship think twice.

items.name: Breaching lance
items.blurb: Burns through a brace as if it were half there. Hungry, and every shot is a cell someone carried up from the hold.

items.name: Drone zap
items.blurb: What a carrier's drone spits at you. One hull point, now and then, until a brace burns the drone out.

items.name: Debris
items.blurb: Not a weapon: a lump of something in a hazard lane that the helm did not see in time (H.6). One hull point and a dent; a brace stops it.
